description: A lightweight tool for deploying and managing containerised applications across a network of Docker hosts. Bridging the gap between Docker and Kubernetes ✨

summary.one_liner: Uncloud is a lightweight, decentralised container orchestration tool that deploys and manages Docker apps across a WireGuard-meshed set of cloud VMs and bare-metal hosts without Kubernetes or Swarm.
summary.what_it_does: Uncloud creates a WireGuard mesh network between Docker hosts and lets you deploy and scale containerised apps across them using a Docker-like CLI (uc) and Docker Compose files. It provides service discovery through a built-in DNS server, load balancing, and ingress with automatic HTTPS via a Caddy reverse proxy that uses Let's Encrypt. Cluster state is shared peer-to-peer through a CRDT-based distributed SQLite database (Corrosion), so there is no central control plane or quorum. Images can be pushed directly to machines without an external registry, transferring only missing layers. Zero-downtime rolling updates and persistent Docker volumes across machines are also listed as features, and the README mentions an optional managed DNS service for public subdomains.
use_cases: deploy web apps across several VPS providers
self-host containers on bare metal or a home server
zero-downtime rolling updates of Docker services
run a highly available app across multiple regions
manage a small Docker cluster without Kubernetes
notable: No central control plane: every machine holds a synchronised copy of cluster state
Zero-config WireGuard mesh with peer discovery and NAT traversal; containers get unique cross-machine IPs
Uses Docker Compose format instead of a new DSL
Built-in Unregistry feature pushes images straight to hosts without a registry
Imperative commands favoured over declarative state reconciliation
caveats: Pre-1.0 and under active development, so breaking changes are expected between releases
Automatic rollback on failure is not yet available (listed as coming soon)
Managed DNS relies on the Uncloud DNS service for public *.uncld.dev records
keywords: deploy web app to my servers
